prTitle: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
head: 62bf98939eda58f0d0a1a41a58aa6d4ecdc24dba

tps.bug: testFeatureNotEnabled only covers the metadata subcommand, so the feature guard in the check subcommand is untested.
tps.evidenciaOpus: UpdateCommandDistTest.testFeatureNotEnabled launches only UpdateCompatibilityMetadata; the identical guard added in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.run() has no disabled-feature test. Missing coverage for a trivial guard.
tps.evidenciaAstra: quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java:46-50 exercises only metadata with the feature disabled, while its check invocations at lines 65, 81, 96 and 105 explicitly enable it. Consequently, the independent disabled-feature guard in quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/cli/command/UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:46-49 has no regression coverage.

tps.bug: The disabled-feature test checks only the error message, not that the command exits with FEATURE_DISABLED (4).
tps.evidenciaOpus: testFeatureNotEnabled only calls cliResult.assertError(...) and never asserts exitCode() == CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED, the new exit code added by the PR.
tps.evidenciaAstra: quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java:48-49 asserts only the diagnostic, and quarkus/tests/junit5/src/main/java/org/keycloak/it/junit5/extension/CLIResult.java:78-80 checks only stderr text. CLITestExtension.java:112-113 captures the distribution result without asserting its status, so an incorrect disabled-feature exit code would pass this test.
